Bluebook Testing Tools

Bluebook makes several tools available to you while you’re testing. Testing Timer: A timer will let you know how much time is remaining in each part of the test. You can hide it until 5 minutes remain, then you’ll get an alert. Calculator:   On the SAT, PSAT-related assessments, and certain AP Exams, you’ll have access to a Desmos calculator. You can drag it anywhere on the screen. Reference Sheet: A reference sheet with commonly used formulas will appear on all tests with math questions. Highlights & Notes:  Use this tool to highlight text from a question or leave yourself a note. Mark for Review: Use the bookmark icon to flag any question you want to come back to. Line Reader: Use this tool to focus as you read test content. Option Eliminator: Cross out answer choices you think are wrong. You can undo this if you change your mind. Question Menu: See which questions you skipped or marked for review and navigate to any question in the section. Zoom: Use keyboard shortcuts on laptops or pinch and zoom on tablets to get a closer look at any part of the question.
